description: Unipi Axon L505 PLC: 24 digital inputs, 4 digital outputs, 19 relay outputs, 5 analog inputs, 5 analog outputs, 1 RS485 line, 1-Wire bus (I/O in 3 groups)

sources.title: Axon L505 Modbus registers (unipi-axon-l505-modbus-registers.xlsx)
sources.note: Sheets Registers - group 1, Registers - group 2, Registers - group 3, Coils - group 1, Coils - group 2, Coils - group 3, Description; listed on https://kb.unipi.technology/en:hw:04-extensions:downloads

notes: Addresses are those of the column 'Via Unit 0' (Modbus TCP unit id 0), where the groups of an Axon controller share one address space: group 1 starts at 0, group 2 at 100, group 3 at 200, and so on. The spreadsheet also gives per-group addresses for unit ids 1, 2 and 3, which are not used here.

Unipi Axon and Neuron use Modbus TCP. By default the Modbus server listens only on the loopback interface; it can be opened to other interfaces by changing its systemd script (Description sheet). The TCP port and the unit id used here are not stated in the spreadsheet: 502 is the Modbus default.

Registers marked Reserved or Obsolete in the spreadsheet, and those named (Internal), are left out. Multi-register values are big-endian (most significant register first). The spreadsheet types Real as a two-register floating point value, read here as float32; its Description sheet text about half and single precision is ambiguous.

Coils (suffix (coil)) repeat digital inputs, outputs and some settings that also appear as bits of holding registers. Analog values are in the unit selected by the analog input or output configuration register; the spreadsheet gives no unit for them.

Some registers (the RS485 line configuration) have no address in the Via Unit 0 column; they are included for group 1 with the Via Unit 1 address, which is identical, and left out for the other groups.
Registers whose name carries no I/O index are repeated in every group of the controller; the name then ends with (group N).
